title: Stringfield files on headband transceivers in recovered craft

tellings.quote: he found numerous mentions of witnesses who had observed recovered UFOs and kind of cutaway diagrams accompanying the UFOs and how in certain retrieval cases, there would seem to be like a headband or headband transceiver uh worn by the operators of the craft

plain: A researcher who goes by the name UAPGerb (UAP is the newer official term for UFOs) says he went through the files of Leonard Stringfield, a UFO researcher based in Cincinnati, Ohio, who wrote a series of seven reports in the 1970s and 80s about crashed craft said to have been recovered. According to UAPGerb, the files mention many witnesses who saw recovered UFOs, along with cutaway diagrams, and in some cases a headband or headband transceiver, a device for sending and receiving signals, worn by the craft's operators. If true, it would hint at how the crews controlled their craft. He also draws on the work of another researcher, Michael Schratt.
